info.name: AI-Powered Banking API
info.description:
Major workflows of the AI Banking API: auth, accounts, transactions with AI risk, beneficiaries, transfers, loans, cards, notifications, AI endpoints, admin.

SETUP: create the first admin once with `python -m app.db.create_admin <email> <password>`, then set the collection variables `adminEmail` and `adminPassword`. Set `baseUrl` to your server (local or Render). Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection Runner; the first request generates fresh test users on every run): it registers fresh users every run and saves tokens/ids into variables automatically.

exec: { // fresh users and references on every run (this request is first in the run)
pm.collectionVariables.set("custaPhone", ph("1")); pm.collectionVariables.set("custbPhone", ph("2")); pm.collectionVariables.set("staffPhone", ph("3"));
pm.test("role is CUSTOMER, no password hash", function () { pm.expect(j.role).to.eql("CUSTOMER"); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property("password_hash"); });
pm.test("role is CUSTOMER, no password hash", function () { pm.expect(j.role).to.eql("CUSTOMER"); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property("password_hash"); });
pm.test("role is CUSTOMER, no password hash", function () { pm.expect(j.role).to.eql("CUSTOMER"); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property("password_hash"); });
pm.test("only my accounts + total header", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Total-Count")).to.eql("1"); });
pm.test("response carries AI risk", function () { const r = pm.response.json().risk; pm.expect(r.risk_level).to.be.oneOf(["LOW","MEDIUM","HIGH"]); pm.expect(r.model_version).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("PENDING, bank-set rate, monthly payment", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(j.interest_rate).to.eql("24.00"); pm.expect(j.monthly_payment).to.eql("1134.72"); });
pm.test("loan notifications present", function () { const t = j.map(n => n.title); pm.expect(t).to.include("Loan approved"); });
